The main takeaway from our work is that
the multi-axial mechanical response of PEEK-Optima™ Ultra-Reinforecd is governed by the interplay of interlaminar delamination and intralaminar cracking, with plasticity playing a secondary role.
the multi-axial failure of medical grade laminated PEEK composites is a combination of inter-laminar and intra-laminar damage and plasticity.
the mechanical behaviour of a unidirectional carbon/PEEK laminate is complex and requires the incorporation of multiple damage mechanisms to accurately predict failure.
